title: Idaeus’ message to the Greeks
intro: Idaeus delivers Paris’s offer and the Trojan proposal of a truce. Diomedes answers that Troy is doomed.

notes.text: παύομαι, cease: aor inf mid, in indirect request; δυσηχής, dreadfully sounding / dolorous: gen sg.
εἰς ὅ κε, until; καίω, burn: 1pl aor subj, epic κήομεν; νεκρούς, the dead.
μάχομαι: 1pl fut; δαίμων, divinity; repeats Hector’s words in 291–292.
ἄμμε = ἡμᾶς; διακρίνω: 3sg aor subj; δίδωμι: 3sg aor subj; ἑτέροισι, to one of two.
κλύω, hear + gen: 3pl impf; πείθομαι, obey: 3pl 2aor mid, unaugmented.
αἱρέομαι, take: 3pl 2aor mid; τέλος, company / unit: dat pl τελέεσσιν.
ἠῶθεν, at dawn; βαίνω, go: 3sg 2aor.
εὑρίσκω, find: 3sg 2aor; εἰν = ἐν; ἀγορή, assembly.
θεράπων, attendant / servant: acc pl; Ἄρηος, of Ares: war-servants.
πάρα = παρά, anastrophe; πρύμνη, stern; νηῦς, ship: dat νηΐ.
ἵστημι, stand: 2aor ptc; μέσσοισιν, in their midst.
μεταφωνέω, speak among: 3sg impf, uncontracted; ἠπύτα, clear-voiced: epic nom sg.
repeats Nestor’s address in 327.
ἄνωγα, bid: 3sg plpf / impf ἠνώγει; ἀγαυός, noble: nom pl.
ὔμμι = ὑμῖν, Aeolic dat pl; περ, emphatic; “if it should be pleasing to you.”
φίλος, welcome; ἡδύς, pleasing; γίγνομαι: 3sg 2aor opt.
repeats 374: νεῖκος, strife; ὄρνυμι: 3sg perf mid.
ἄγομαι, bring for oneself: 3sg 2aor mid; Τροίηνδε, to Troy.
ὀφείλω + aor inf, an unfulfilled wish: “would that he had perished first”; ἀπόλλυμαι: aor inf mid.
repeats 364: δίδωμι: aor inf; ἐπιτίθημι, add: aor inf.
κουρίδιος, lawful (wife); ἄλοχος, wife; κυδάλιμος, glorious: gen sg masc.
φημί: 3sg pres; δίδωμι: fut inf; he says he will not give her up.
ἦ μήν, indeed; κέλομαι, urge: 3pl pres mid, i.e. even though the Trojans urge it.
ἄνωγα: 3pl plpf / impf ἠνώγεον; ἐθέλω: 2pl pres subj.
repeats 376–378 in full: the truce proposal in the herald’s own words.
repeats 92: ἀκήν, silent; γίγνομαι: 3pl 2aor.
ὀψέ, late; βοὴν ἀγαθός, good at the war-cry (acc of respect).
μήτε … μήτε, neither … nor; δέχομαι, accept: 3sg pres imperative.
γνωτός, plain; ὅς, even one who; νήπιος, foolish: “plain even to a fool.”
ὄλεθρος, ruin; πεῖραρ, cord / end; ἐφάπτω, fasten on: 3sg perf pass.
ἐπιάχω, shout approval: 3pl impf; υἷες = υἱοί.
